name: EPIC 205930631
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 3, 9.4 solar radii and 0.82 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

text.card: A red giant 4,301 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.82 solar masses and 9.4 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,874 K at its surface.
